summary: Pin is in steep bush with no track; nothing a van can reach.
reasons: No road, track or vehicles seen

drivers.seclusion: Deep in bush, though homes sit about 50 m east at the bush edge.
drivers.access_and_room: No formed track or clearing near the pin; the cul-de-sac is a residential street outside the reserve.
drivers.convention: No sign of vehicles or camping.
